1_note_paint_order.java_trace: StateDiagramFactory builds note-on-entity commands for ParserPass.THREE (StateDiagram.getRequiredPass ONE..THREE), so the note quark is appended after the pass-ONE quarks of its declaring group (Quark.children LinkedHashMap; Entity.leafs). GraphvizImageBuilder.printGroup prints g.leafs() then printGroups(g); buildImage prints groups then getUnpackagedEntities; SvekResult.drawU paints Bibliotekon.allNodes() in creation order. A note is therefore the last leaf of its declaring group's bucket. Applied to GroupMakerState regions and to the root cluster path.

2_image_border_points.java_trace: Cluster.manageEntryExitPoint takes each border node's SvekNode.getRectangleArea().getPointCenter() (corner from DotStringFactory.solve, image dimension 12) and SvekResult.drawU draws EntityImageStateBorder at that corner, so the circle centre is the node centre plus the shielded table's P-cell offset, as the Rust root path already computed. The image path used the table corner plus half the 12 px image: (6 - layout_width/2, 6 - 18) = (-21, -12) for the 54 px table. Port P: Link.getEntityPort writes uid:P for every entry/exit point (EntityPort.forPort) and SvekNode.appendLabelHtmlSpecialForPortBasic declares no port for labels <= 40 px, so Java's own dot run warns too; AbstractGraphviz.createFile3 captures dot's error stream and never writes it. Rust's DOT keeps Java's uid:P; the in-process Graphviz now uses a discarding agusererrf.
